--
Press once for the next channel, twice for the previous one.
  1. Connect your Clip Pro, then tap Start listening once.
  2. You can then lock the screen. Keep this page open in the background.
  3. Press 3 times to switch between instance 1 (time and weather) and instance 2 (radio).
  4. In instance 1, press once to slide between Time and Weather.
  5. In instance 1, press twice to hear the time or the weather again, depending on the slide.
  6. In instance 2, press once for the next radio channel, or twice to go back to the previous channel.
